title: TS-56 Second live computer rehearsal: write_workspace, disk dirty guard, snapshots, browse
description: TS-53 proved run_terminal only. Rehearse live on development: write_workspace then a recycle (second host start) to exercise the disk dirty guard (relocate refused while dirty), snapshot publish at host exit and hydrate at the next start, the live-writer lock, the claim refusal while hydrate is required; then browse with a task size that fits Chromium (the task definition is 256 CPU and 512 MB; raising it is a ChatticusComputers stack change, a shared stack: no --all, never destroy; decide with the user). Depends on TS-55 for visibility. Same approval rules as TS-53: the user's go before image push, tasks and any stack change.

comments.author: home
comments.text: SECOND LIVE REHEARSAL, development, PASS. Turn 1 (host start #1): write_workspace /workspace/ts56.txt then read_workspace, reply ts56-hello-snapshot, turn.completed in 40 s (host claim at +30 s incl. Fargate cold start). The host self-exited about 160-170 s after the last tool result: record stopped=true, disk_dirty=false, snapshot_generation=1, checksum and URI present; snapshot objects tenants/integration-test/computers/<id>/manifest.json (306 B) and snapshot.tar.gz (243 B). Turn 2 (host start #2, a recycle): read_workspace returned ts56-hello-snapshot, so the file survived the recycle (hydrate indirect: a fresh container read it); cold start to result 28 s; host exited again, generation 2. 3 host starts total (1 from TS-53), cleanup: both hosts self-exited, 0 tasks (verified), all DLQs 0, no Lambda errors. NOT exercised live: the dirty guard (relocate refused while dirty), the hydrate-required claim refusal and the live-writer lock: no HTTP route relocates a computer or attempts a write while hydrate is required and the record exposes no live-writer field, so those stay covered by cucumber only. Browse not run (512 MB task too small for Chromium: decision needed). Findings filed: TS-58 (stale record after a killed host), TS-59 (non-deterministic snapshot pack rewrites every exit); observability items added to TS-55.

right_now_summary: The live rehearsal passed workspace persistence, but dirty-guard, lock, claim-refusal, and browse checks remain
